unit_system: natural-HEP: GeV for beam energies and sqrt(s); luminosity in cm^-2 s^-1 as the facility documents quote it; polarization as a fraction or percent, stated per claim
energy_variable: beam energies E_e x E_h per named collision configuration (GeV; per nucleon for ions) with sqrt(s) derived and stated alongside; never a single implicit energy
frame: laboratory frame with asymmetric beams: the lab and center-of-mass frames differ, and every boost or crossing-angle correction is stated per configuration from its source
eic:beam_energy_configuration: a named pair (E_e, E_h) with species and polarization, taken from the cited source and release; this profile does not fix a default configuration
eic:hadron_beam_direction: the sign of the z axis relative to the hadron beam is not fixed by this profile: take it from the ePIC geometry release the analysis uses and record it; unknown until then
eic:polarization_sign: helicity and transverse-polarization sign conventions follow the cited analysis or facility document; this profile does not fix them; unknown until stated
eic:ion_energy_normalization: ion beam energies are per nucleon unless a claim says whole-ion; every conversion states A and Z
